items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: They had my band, and I had a, I had a very good aggregation there that night from the sense of musicians. I mean, it was like, like Pinky Vedakovich on sax and Jordy on sax. And, uh, uh, Baduk on drums, Billy Braun on mellophone, uh, Joe Lorcanna trombone.

ctx.x: Oh, that's who I was trying to think.

Billy Braun, he played piano. And, uh, many times, rehearse the band with, uh, numbers. A new number come out, Billy would play it, see? And we might say, play it again. And he'd play it again, and, uh, then, uh, then we'd take it. He'd switch over. But, uh, we were playing, uh, we were playing the, uh, the Spinsters Ball in, uh, Biloxi, Mississippi. A carnival ball. items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: when i worked with norman brownlee and and uh and emmon hardy we used to work every night in the week

ctx.x: what kind of jobs did you work in those days uh you'd have pretty steady jobs for a while and then spot
